$comment: Ground truth for toy_invalid.json. Row indexes are 0-based array positions. One seeded violation per row; tools/validate.py fixtures asserts each row FAILS with an error pointer on the named column. No skip-break/applicability-break case: this mother file has no if/then routing rules yet -- the source schema did not establish clear cross-field skip logic for this table's fields (e.g. R0_AgeMenopause has no NA branch even though R0_Menopause=2 'Premenopausal' would logically make it inapplicable), so none was invented. Logged as an open item in DECISIONS.md for steward input. No duplicate-row case: validate.py fixtures checks each row independently against the item schema, never the array-level uniqueItems constraint; verified separately via 'validate.py data' against a two-identical-row file.
